data.detailed_description: Experience the "Turtle Ride" at Chimmini WLS! Embark on a unique and enchanting journey with our "Turtle Ride" – an eco-tourism program that offers a delightful perspective of the serene waters within Chimmini Wildlife Sanctuary. Step into our "Turtle," a charming, round-shaped country boat crafted from natural bamboo, designed to blend harmoniously with its surroundings. For a blissful 20 minutes, you'll gently glide across the tranquil waters, allowing you to immerse yourself in the sights and sounds of the sanctuary's vibrant ecosystem. But the real thrill? If your coracle decides to spin, hold on for an extra splash of excitement! The unexpected twirls add an element of playful adventure, making your "Turtle Ride" truly unforgettable and awesome. Perfect for families, nature lovers, and those seeking a peaceful yet exhilarating experience, the "Turtle Ride" offers a wonderful opportunity to connect with nature and create lasting memories. Key Features: Traditional Bamboo Coracle: Experience an authentic and eco-friendly boat ride. 20-Minute Duration: A perfect short excursion to enjoy the tranquility. Potential for "Awesome Spins": Adds an exciting and memorable element to your journey! Immersive Nature Experience: Get up close with the natural beauty of Chimmini WLS. Come and discover the magic of the "Turtle Ride" – where tradition meets adventure in the heart of Chimmini!
data.description: Chimmony Wildlife Sanctuary, nestled in the Western Ghats of Thrissur district is a hidden gem for nature lovers. This pristine sanctuary boasts lush tropical rainforests, cascading waterfalls, and diverse wildlife, making it a perfect destination for trekking, birdwatching, and wildlife spotting. The sanctuary is home to dense evergreen and semi-evergreen forests, providing a habitat for a variety of flora and fauna. Visitors can enjoy trekking, cycling, turtle ride, offered by the Kerala Forest Department.
